entries.jp: 貴様達に真の平等を\n与えるのが　我の使命
entries.en: It is my mission to\ngrant you true\nequality.

entries.jp: 人々が自分の都合で\n好き放題していては\n泰平の世など望めない
entries.en:
So long as people
do whatever they
please for their
own convenience,
a world of peace
is beyond hope.

entries.jp: 井伊\nそれは違う！
entries.en: Ii, you got it all\nwrong!

entries.jp: 好き勝手にワガママを\n言うのと自由にするのは\n違う！
entries.en:
Throwin' selfish
tantrums and
bein' free ain't the
same thing!

entries.jp: 喜びだけじゃない\n苦しみ　悲しみ\nそれすら分かち合って
entries.en:
Not just the
joy--the pain, the
sorrow, sharin'
even that...

entries.jp: みんなで前に進むのが\n真の泰平だろう！
entries.en:
...and movin'
forward
together--that's
true peace, ain't
it!?

entries.jp: そんな綺麗事を認める\nわけにはいかんのだよ
entries.en:
I'm afraid I
cannot accept
such pretty
ideals.

entries.jp: 解き放たれた人々が\n暴徒と化して　いずれは\n戦になるだろう
entries.en:
Unleashed, the
people will turn
into a mob, and
sooner or later,
there will be war.

entries.jp: そんなことはない！
entries.en: That ain't true!

entries.jp: 楽しく歌って過ごす方が\n泰平だって　みんな\nわかってるはずじゃ！
entries.en:
Everybody oughta
know that singin'
and havin' fun
together is what
peace really is!

entries.jp: 思い上がるな！\n下郎が
entries.en: Do not flatter\nyourself, you\npeasant!

entries.jp: 我の天歌で\n真の泰平の意味を\n理解させてやろう！
entries.en:
With my Heaven's
Song, I shall make
you understand
what true peace
means!

entries.jp: ヒジゾーさん\nソウちん\n援護を頼むぜよ
entries.en:
Hijizo-san!
So-chin! Back me
up, I'm countin'
on ya!

entries.jp: 任せろ\n坂本
entries.en: Leave it to me,\nSakamoto.

entries.jp: 存分に歌って！\nトサカくん！
entries.en: Sing your heart\nout, Tosaka-kun!

entries.jp: シンディ！\nセンセーも！\n頼んだぜよ！
entries.en: Shindy! You too,\nSensei! I'm\ncountin' on ya!

entries.jp: オレ様を差し置いて\n頼んだもクソもあるかよ！\n死ぬ気で歌え！
entries.en:
"Counting on"
them, and you
skip the great
Takasugi!? Just
sing like your life
depends on it!

entries.jp: 準備万端だよ！\nさあ　はじめよう
entries.en: Everything is\nready! Now, let us\nbegin.

entries.jp:
その時
五つに分かたれていた
片魂（ピースソウル）が
光を放ち始めた
entries.en:
At that moment,
the Piece Souls,
which had been
split into five,
began to glow.

entries.jp:
その光は
踊るように近づいて
ひとつの大きな
光に変わる
entries.en:
The lights drew
closer as if
dancing, and
turned into one
great light.

entries.jp: ……これはっ！\n超魂の輝き
entries.en: ...This is...! The\nradiance of the\nUltra Soul!

entries.jp: 今こそ\n魂をひとつにして\n歌おう
entries.en: Now's the time to\nmake our souls\none and sing!

entries.jp: キタキタキタぁぁぁ！\nこのリズムぜよ！\nこの音色ぜよぉぉぉおお！
entries.en:
Here it comes,
here it comes,
here it COMES!
This rhythm! This
soooound!

entries.jp: 無限の熱情がわき上がる！\n魂が震えるぜよ！\nもう止められない！
entries.en:
Endless passion's
welling up! My
soul's shakin'!
There's no
stoppin' it now!

entries.jp: 井伊！\nわしらのロックを聴け！\nわしらの歌を受けとめろ！
entries.en: Ii! Listen to our\nrock! Take our\nsong head-on!

entries.jp: うぉぉおおおおお！
entries.en: Wooooaaahhh!

entries.jp: これが――\nわしが――
entries.en: This is-- I am--

entries.jp: ロックじゃぁぁぁぁあああ
entries.en: ROOOOOCK,\ny'hear!

entries.jp: \fnt1烈（レッツ）\nロックンロォォル\fnt0
entries.en: \fnt1Let's rock 'n'\nrooooll!\fnt0
